note: home_guess and gap_candidates are an advisory guess, before the held-in-other-words notes: the plan names each sentence's home topic and judges it there. home_guess is null when no measured topic holds the sentence or shares 40% of its words (its home may be a topic not measured: outside `via`, or a new topic), and when two topics tie. Each unmeasured_sentences sentence (a piece cookr did not measure, or one no sentence could be given) is judged by hand at its home topic and is a gap unless held: its held_at and lacking_at are empty. Where some of its pieces were measured, their verdicts are under measured_pieces: they cover those pieces only and are not a verdict on the sentence, which is not held until judged by hand (a lacking_by_home_guess row for it carries measured: false). Each unplaced_pieces entry is a piece no one sentence could be given: judge it by hand, with each sentence its `sentences` names; none of them is held because of it.
